scene: Through the telescope lens, three distant transport stations gleam across the city.
picture: A circular telescope viewport looking out over Pixel City's skyline. On the left sits a sleek pink bullet train on an elevated track. In the centre waits a red maglev dragon train beside lantern-lit platforms. On the right, a spherical cloud cable pod dangles from a high cable wire.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train idling on an open track on the left
a glowing red maglev dragon train waiting at a platform in the centre
a spherical cloud cable pod swaying on a high wire on the right
